card.name: Words just before falling asleep
card.fires_on: Linking words such as during, going, to, difficulty or of right before an expected 'asleep' or 'sleep', mostly in insomnia and sleep-medication text.

modes.label: Trouble getting to sleep
modes.description: Words like difficulty, going or ability that come right before 'to sleep' or 'falling asleep'.

modes.label: Sleep timing phrases
modes.description: Words such as during or of that come before sleep or falling-asleep terms.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict fall/falling (as in falling asleep) and away from sleep itself.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'asleep' or 'sleep' in sentences about trouble falling asleep.
